issues.detail: The Vietnamese phrase 'đẹp lòng Ta mọi đường' (pleasing to me in every way/path) is an addition/distortion. The Greek 'εις ον εγω ευδοκησα' means 'in whom I have pleased' or 'whom I have delighted in.' It describes the Father's delight in the Son, not the Son's behavior or 'paths' being pleasing to the Father.
